summary: Advect educational tracers over a supplied small regular rectilinear CF lon/lat current grid using one declared frozen local east/north tangent-plane approximation, only while time and every interpolation corner remain valid.
objective: Advect educational tracers over a supplied small regular rectilinear CF lon/lat current grid using one declared frozen local east/north tangent-plane approximation, only while time and every interpolation corner remain valid.
example_prompts: Build cf ocean-current grid particle playback with explicit units, frames, time and unavailable-data states.

entities.name: Field ledger
entities.guidance: Record dataset hash, CF version, u/v standard names/units, grid mapping, coordinates, vertical level, time units/calendar and fill/valid ranges.

entities.name: Grid sampler
entities.guidance: Use bilinear horizontal plus linear time interpolation only inside one valid cell/bracket; reject missing corner or land mask.

entities.name: Tracer trails
entities.guidance: Seed deterministic massless display tracers and store accepted solver states plus stop reason.

state_contract.model: Accept only a finite regular rectilinear CF grid with monotone 1D longitude, latitude and time coordinates and compatible eastward/northward velocity units converted to m/s. Declare finite R>0 and origin lon0,lat0; require every latitude including lat0 to satisfy |lat|<=80 degrees so cos(lat0) is safely nonzero, plus authored small-patch bound max(|(lon-lon0)*cos(lat0)|,|lat-lat0|)<=0.05 radians. Convert radians once to frozen local east/north metres X=R*cos(lat0)*(lon-lon0), Y=R*(lat-lat0), explicitly treating this as a local tangent approximation; in this declared frame set dX/dt=u_east and dY/dt=v_north. Bilinearly sample one regular horizontal cell and linearly sample one time bracket. Every RK4 stage requires an in-domain bracket and four valid corners at both endpoints; terminate on missing/fill/land data. Bound dt and duration; reject projected, curvilinear, rotated-pole, cross-dateline and larger grids.
state_contract.authority: The CF variable metadata, stable dataset hash, monotone lon/lat/time arrays, declared vertical slice/calendar and frozen local tangent convention own numeric state. Blender/glTF holds only a matching local-frame coast/terrain context; Three.js performs unit conversion, strict sampling, RK4 updates, stop reasons and seed-exact reset.

invariants: Every RK stage uses the one frozen local east/north tangent frame; projected, curvilinear, rotated-pole, cross-dateline or out-of-bound patches are rejected instead of silently mixing east/north components with grid axes.
Finite R>0 and the authored |latitude|<=80-degree guard keep the frozen tangent mapping invertible; this latitude cutoff is recipe policy, not a CF requirement.
Calendar/time units remain attached to playback time.
Trail brightness/length never represents mass or certainty.
motion_guidance: Playback follows stored model/data time; reverse scrub is history and display interpolation never changes the numeric model.
creative_affordances: Use scale-separated context, glyphs and trails while disclosing exaggeration and keeping uncertainty visible.
known_limits: No forecast, dataset execution, numerical solve, render or runtime validation was performed.

claims.statement: CF Conventions define coordinate/grid-mapping metadata, time units and calendars, and missing/valid-range attributes for geophysical variables; coordinate values locate grid points.
claims.scope: CF 1.13 stable/current convention concepts read 2026-09-08; this recipe authors its stricter interpolation rejection policy.

object_craft.structure: Blender authors coastline/terrain context already transformed into the same declared frozen local east/north display frame plus reusable vector/particle glyphs; glTF exports static context, axes and stable node names, never CF arrays.
object_craft.material: Mask cells use pattern and boundary geometry; particles are visibly explanatory.
object_craft.articulation: Three.js owns CF metadata/input arrays, radians-to-frozen-ENU metres, east/north velocity binding, strict space/time interpolation, RK4 accepted states, explicit stop reasons and deterministic reset.

physical_contract.scope: Massless tracer advection in supplied current data; no ocean forecast or particle physics.
physical_contract.timestep: Bounded model-time RK4 step with validity checks at every stage.
